simple.summary: קֶרֶת (qereth) means a city First listed occurrence: Job 29 7.

definitions.full: H7176. qereth [ קֶ֫רֶת ] noun feminine town, city (late poetry) (compare Phoenician חדשת קרת proper name, of a location in Cyprus, also = Carthage , and perhaps Cirta, Tigranocerta ; compare Thes); — always קָ֑רֶת ; — of Job's city, Job 29:7 ; indefinite Prov 8:3 ; 9:3 , 14 ; city as a corporate body of men 11:11 .
definitions.rootNote: from 7136 in the sense of building;
